title: Set a custom icon for a file or folder
summary: Use the `fileicon` tool to assign a custom image as the icon for a specific file or directory. This changes how the item appears in Finder.
prerequisites: The `fileicon` tool must be installed (e.g., via Homebrew).
You need a valid image file (usually .png or .icns) to use as the icon.

steps.explain: Run the `fileicon set` command, specifying the target file or directory and the path to the image file you want to use as the icon.

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the file or folder you want to change the icon for.

placeholders.name: ICON_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the image file (e.g., .png or .icns) to use as the new icon.
